title: Gluing completeness through stratum-local isomorphisms
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and I an ideal of A. Let s be a finite constructible locally closed scheme stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. For every stratum alpha fix a covering sieve V_alpha on the terminal object of its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let K be any derived object with coefficients in adicLisseCompletedRing X I. Suppose that for every arrow U to the terminal object belonging to V_alpha there is a derived object L with the same global coefficients such that IsSfbAdicComplete X I L and the sfbLocalRestriction of K at alpha,U is isomorphic to that of L; all these constructions are those of [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. Then IsSfbAdicComplete X I K. No perfect-model, boundedness, or constructibility hypothesis on K or L is imposed; L may depend on the covering arrow.

proof.text: Forget only constructibility from the given stratification, retaining its domains and immersions. Choose finite generators of I by Noetherianity. Push each covering sieve through AsSmall.up; the dense site equivalence preserves covering sieves and identifies their arrows through AsSmall.down.

Normalize K and all its complete comparison objects by the explicit completed-coefficient isomorphism. For each stratum choose algebraic inverse-image data from its geometric adjunction. Apply the normalized local restriction isomorphism lemma to the original local isomorphism K|U isomorphic to L|U. The preservation clauses of adicStratumCompletionUnit make the normalized restriction of L complete. Invariance of local internal-Hom vanishing under isomorphism then makes the normalized restriction of K complete.

Apply the reverse implication of adicStratumCompletionUnit_detection to the normalized K and the transported covering sieves. Its conclusion is global normalized completeness. The explicit normalization completeness equivalence yields IsSfbAdicComplete X I K. The detection theorem includes empty strata and empty X.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.6.11 reverse implication; explicit coefficient normalization and isomorphism transport, then the existing stratum completion-unit preservation and detection theorems.

Six hits, including SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence and its unit/counit formulas. This constructs the underlying module equivalence but does not identify these coefficient complexes or transport the local derived completeness tests.

lean.statement:
theorem sfbAdicComplete_of_stratum_local_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (s : Stratification X)
    (V : ∀ α : Fin s.n, Sieve (⊤_ (s.domain α).ProEt))
    (hV : ∀ α : Fin s.n,
      V α ∈ ProEt.topology (s.domain α) (⊤_ (s.domain α).ProEt))
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)))
    (hlocal : ∀ (α : Fin s.n) (U : (s.domain α).ProEt)
      (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ (s.domain α).ProEt), V α f →
      ∃ L : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)),
        IsSfbAdicComplete X I L ∧
          Nonempty (sfbLocalRestriction (s.immersion α) (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U K ≅
            sfbLocalRestriction (s.immersion α) (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U L)) :
    IsSfbAdicComplete X I K
